svg.text: Decode — register files, branch resolution, exceptions, ID/EX
Upper band: one row per ID/EX operand, flowing left to right into the
register column. A mux chain is the literal VHDL if/elsif: the last mux
holds the highest-priority condition. ControlPath inputs drop from the top
edge onto the select they drive. Lower band: branch_correction resolves the
branch and ILLEGAL_detector checks it; everything returning to fetch leaves
through the bottom edge. IR_in is one bus (top left, down the trunk, along
the channel between the bands); its fields are dotted taps. clk and rst
reach every clocked element by tag.
data bus — width at the slash tick
